quest.title: Back to Normal: The Story Hidden in the Bottle
quest.description: After retrieving all of the components, the Mirage can finally be returned to working order. All that was hidden will be revealed at the hub...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Head to the hub of the Mirage

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Eula and Collei! You got back before us!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Yes. Idyia had the Water Droplet send us a message just as the show was coming to an end, so we came back here to wait for you.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: How is Lessig doing...?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: He finished all the maintenance work, but it took a lot out of him. He's now fast asleep in his room.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Oh... I feel a little guilty...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Consider it his atonement. It's only fair that he had to do something constructive before being able to sleep soundly. Seriously, don't waste your concern on him.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: If you say so... Okay. Without further ado, let's go and fix the domain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't this where we first met Water Droplet?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Correct. The core of the Veluriyam Mirage is the largest Streaming Projector of all. And this domain is one gigantic preprint.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: So everything we've seen is created by this? That's incredible...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, to fix it, it's the same process as usual, right? Do we need to use the preprint?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Exactly. Well done, you catch on quick.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's hard to forget after doing it so many times now.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Let's get going. This is the final step!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay! Suddenly, Paimon's really excited!

talks.objective: Use the preprints to fix the Central Hub

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Something that spins... Would a water wheel count?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We did it!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: But why isn't it turning...?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: The components are back in the core, and the hub is restored to its proper shape again.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's all we needed to do. Like any wound, it just needs time to heal. It'll probably just start turning again one day in the middle of the night, when no one's looking...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Really? I thought that with your special abilities, you could get it turning again right away.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: What...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: All of us are dying to see it. Not just how the domain looks when it's fixed, but also Idyia... in her element.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I wanna see Idyia using her magic powers, too! I bet they're super awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... What are you guys talking about? And how is Klee in on this but Paimon isn't?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Haven't you noticed, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: They're referring to... our mascot's true form.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: As I've said all along, there's much more to Idyia than she gives herself credit for. She has a very special power... Though I think some of us have sensed that already.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Did you notice right away, General? I only found out when I was chatting with Eula.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: So our General was the first to notice? It seems like she's more perceptive than she lets on...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I'd say the same about you, Kaeya.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: What the... All of you know? ...I mean, I wasn't trying to hide anything from you, I promise!

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: It's just... For people who stumble upon this place by accident, I think my current form is more approachable than my true one... I—I don't want people to get scared when they see me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? What is it? And whatever it is, how the heck does everyone know about it?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Um... Well for one thing, I sensed elemental energy in the residents here, but none of them have Visions.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Then my mind started to wander as I was reading a story book, and suddenly I had a thought. Since Hydro Eidolons can change into any form... why not human form?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: You hit the nail on the head...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Alright. In that case, please allow me to introduce myself once more:

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: I am an Oceanid who was exiled here when the former Hydro Archon passed away. My name is Idyia.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: An Oceanid...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Wow, Idyia, you're so pretty!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Heh... Now that I'm in my true form, I suddenly feel a little embarrassed talking to you all...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: You look stunning. You should be flaunting this look at every opportunity.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Come on, I'm too shy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... So does this mean that all the people we met in here are actually...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'm guessing that the human counterparts to these Hydro alter egos are long gone.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: That's right. When they wanted to leave, I took them to the edge of the desert...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: The "components" are, in fact, gifts that they gave to me before they left.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: But I'm always curious about what brings people here... So I used the Streaming Projector to bring their wishes to life.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The power to grant wishes... but only within the confines of the bottle.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Exactly.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: It's a truly extraordinary light.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I've just realized something... When the components fell from the core, it appeared as if they had returned to their respective owners. But actually...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: It was after the components landed where they did that their owners and the things associated with them arose around them to form the different zones.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: So now that the components have been retrieved, does that mean that all those things are gone...?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Don't worry, they'll be quite safe. As long as I remember them... they'll never disappear.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: However much we might criticize each other, or get into scuffles... In this mirage, they will always be my friends.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I had so much fun in the Choo-Choo Cart and hanging out with Mr. Director! I'll never forget them either!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Me neither. I'll always remember my adventures in this fantasy land.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Haha, very good. But it's probably time I set this wheel in motion.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: This one's all yours, Idyia! Our magical mascot.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaah... please work...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Huh? That's strange, nothing happened... Has it lost some power because of the incident?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Oh, crumbs... Not now, not right off the back of everyone putting me on a pedestal... And me acting like this was going to be my big moment...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: *sob* Someone get me a bottle, I'm hiding myself away! See you in a hundred years!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... You're already in a bottle...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: What now? This was the only way... Now I'll never be able to show you how the Veluriyam Mirage is supposed to look...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Hold on... I have an idea.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Yes, General Sangonomiya? I'm all ears!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: If it's okay with you, would you let me borrow the Shinrou Casket from the domain's core?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Ah, the Shinrou Casket... That sounds familiar. One second...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Here, is this it?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Wow! A huge shell!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's the relic that Kokomi mentioned earlier! So this is where it's been hiding!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: It was once a ritual vessel used for making offerings in the Mouun Shrine. It's made from the remains of a youkai called the shinkirou, and it can listen to the wishes of those who come to pray to build up "shinki," which gives it its power.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Several centuries ago, the relic was lost when the last Prefect of Yashiori died in battle. Its final resting place was unknown...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The pearl that goes with it should be able to sense the casket's location. But when, unbeknownst to anyone at the time, the casket disappeared inside the core of the Veluriyam Mirage, the pearl's light died out.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Huh? How come?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Well, imagine it was a sound instead of light. If the room is too big, you can't hear anything from outside the door, can you?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Ohhh! I get it now. The shell must've been having too much fun one day, and got locked in the solitary confinement room.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: I understand now, too! The core has been wearing out recently... That's why you were able to follow the pearl all the way here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Sounds just like my Treasure Compasses...)

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: ...To get back to the story, without the offerings at the shrine, this vessel quickly loses its power...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Yet countless people who have visited this domain brought their wishes with them, and left a small piece of themselves behind along with their gifts. These have the same effect as the offerings at the shrine.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Wow... I never knew this thing was so powerful...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: It is. Powerful enough to help you repair the Veluriyam Mirage, with any luck.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: But... what do I do with it...?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: It's simple. We just need to awaken it by telling it what we wish for.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: For example... My name is Sangonomiya Kokomi, the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: And my wish is to use my critical thinking and strategic planning skills to bring a little more joy into the lives of my fellow Watatsumi Islanders, as well as the lives of everyone I cherish.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Idyia, what do you wish for?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Me? I...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: My wish is that all those who have sojourned to the Veluriyam Mirage in the past will achieve what they truly wish for. Not just in this domain, but out there, too.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Even though I know full well that trying to build a railway in the outside world is just a pipe dream... and that Maymunah will probably just go back to being a scholar...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: And I know that Zosimos has a lot of improving to do as a playwright... it's going to be tough for him back in Fontaine. Chasing your dreams is hard work!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Despite all of that, I still hope...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: That somehow, someday, they will achieve their dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yay, Idyia, you're back to normal!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Everyone's praise and curious questions went to my head... I said so many things I'm so ashamed of, and I... I lost the courage to live on.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Please don't say that. Yours was a noble wish.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Yeah. And you weren't granting wishes for yourself. You did it for other people.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I have friends like that, too! Other people's hopes and dreams are what motivate them. They'll work tirelessly just to see them smile.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: If you ask me... That's one of the most noble things a person can aspire to.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Please, no more praise... I—I'm really not comfortable with it... It makes me feel so ashamed...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Someone like me doesn't deserve so many people's praise... It's like I'm dreaming.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Well, at least the domain is fixed now. And all the components are back in place.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Mmm...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: What's the matter, Klee?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I suddenly have loads and loads of more wishes! I wanna ride the Choo-Choo Cart again, and look down from up on top of the big wheel!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Is there a way to get up on top of the wheel, Idyia?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: There is a way, but there's only space for a very few people...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #That's okay, I can go up by myself! ...Um, but it'd be more fun with {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shall not leave your side, my lady.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are we sure about this? It's so high...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What happens if we fall off?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...I thought you could fly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well yeah, but... Paimon's just worried for you!

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'll be there to make sure no one falls off. I haven't been up there in a long time myself.

talks.objective: Prepare to get on the Central Hub's wheel

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It's like doing a jigsaw puzzle...

talks.objective: Get on the Central Hub's wheel
Ride to the top of the Central Hub

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Whenever people have to leave this domain, I like to come up here and spend some time alone after I've seen them out.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: They're always overjoyed when they first arrive and start bringing their imaginations to life...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: But once they realize that they can't take anything home with them, they get upset. Some of them can't bear to leave, others regret ever setting foot in this place.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Do you ever get sad, Idyia?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: ...I feel lonely, at times. But not sad.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: A lot of people destroy everything they created before leaving. But some don't, like the residents you met.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Before they left, they asked me to make replicas of themselves using Hydro Eidolons. Then they tasked these replicas with maintaining everything they built here... as if this was their way of keeping their dreams alive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's beautiful.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Yeah. I don't know how they're faring in the outside world, but... just the thought that one day, they might achieve their dreams, and live on the outside just as their counterparts do in here... That's enough to make me happy.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: It feels like... I'm here waiting for them in the future, where they've achieved everything they wanted.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're so nice, Idyia.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Uhh... really?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: ...I just think that every dream, every wish, is like a flame in a bottle.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Whether someone is still working towards their dream, or living it already...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: As long as whenever they think back to that spark of light within them, it still makes them smile fondly... That's all it takes.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Well, I feel super happy right now!

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Haha, then I guess I've finally paid Alice back after all these years. Funny to think I've been in the middle of a desert this whole time... it's just a giant muddy swamp to me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Time for Paimon to give you a nickname! Mud Fairy! Watch out for Idyia the Mud Fairy.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: How dare you mock me! Roar, I'll gobble you up in one mouthful!

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: ...I'm still embarrassed to have shown you my uglier side, but I'm glad the Veluriyam Mirage is up and running again. This place is going to be bustling with activity again soon enough. I hope you'll take some time to enjoy yourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, we still have some dreams to attend to...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yep, I wanna get everyone together...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: For one last ride on the Choo-Choo Cart!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Umm... If I remember correctly, I think there's supposed to be a small cog on the right-hand side.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: So maybe that's the candy box?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Mm... I guess it'll be time for us to leave once this is fixed.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: What's making that shadow? Is it the rope?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm... I feel like the rope should go from one part to another to connect them together...

dialogues.speaker: Zosimos
dialogues.text: You're going to attempt to repair the core now, right? I hope it goes smoothly.

dialogues.speaker: Zosimos
dialogues.text: I feel so honored to have met you all. You were a wonderful cast! Thank you once again. I'm so grateful for everything you have done for me.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Wait, this is Zosimos's bottle-lamp...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Try sticking it in somewhere where there's a gap. Maybe on the right.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: The hub consists of these components. All you need to do is place them onto the foundation in the right shape...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The right shape? But we've never seen what it looks like...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Ah, don't worry about it... Close enough will do. As long as it can spin, it'll be fine! Should be fine... I think...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Sometimes, you have no standards whatsoever...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: "Welcome to the Veluriyam Mirage. I hope you can relax and enjoy some respite from your tiring journey."

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: That's how I would have greeted you if things had been different... *sigh* It's hard to believe how much has happened.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Since everything's fixed now, I thought... Better late than never. What do you think? Pretty professional, huh?
